title: Hearty Crisp Brazilian Wensleydale En Croute
description: A savory Brazilian dish featuring Wensleydale cheese in a crisp en croute pastry, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This recipe is also diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together the diced chicken, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
Spread the chicken mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Crumble the Wensleydale cheese over the chicken mixture.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Place the en croute on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
